title: Gruel
summary: Eat for 3d4 healing without a combat resource cost, or contribute 1 Camp Supply.

fields.Eating: Consume one portion to restore 3d4 HP. The pinned source reports no combat action cost and ordinary on-heal triggers.
fields.Acquisition: Okta in the Emerald Grove’s Hollow gives a portion per speaking character. Halflings and characters disguised as halflings can get two from a particular dialogue option.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence.
